text:
Bea: hi team — Bea here, starting today as a product designer. quick hiccup: i accepted the Figma invite but i can't see our team libraries or the components file. also can't locate the live product roadmap in Notion or any interview/screener templates. who should i ping to get me fully unblocked? thanks!

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Bea :tada:  Invite sent to bea@redwood.ai. If libraries are missing try `/admin figma refresh-me` or open Figma > Plugins > Team Libraries > Refresh. Roadmap (live): https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap-Live-9f7b. Research templates: Notion > Product > Research > Study templates. Recording store: Google Drive folder "research-recordings" (link on the Research index page). Please join #design-oncall and #research-ops.

Bea: tried the refresh and a hard reload — still not seeing the components library.

Marco: hey Bea  welcome! I'm Marco (Design Ops). DM'd you to confirm your figma email and i'll add you manually to the "Product Design" team. FYI tokens are canonical in our repo: `github.com/redwood/design-tokens` (file: tokens.json). We have a CI job `tokens-sync` that pushes to Figma hourly; if something's stale i can trigger `./scripts/publish-tokens.sh` for you.

Product Onboarding Bot: manual add queued by Marco. If you still don't see libraries after 2 minutes try incognito or visit https://www.figma.com/files/recent.

Bea: i can see the libraries now, thanks Marco! quick follow-up: where are past interview scripts and the consent wording? want to reuse a screener.

Tess: hey Bea, Research Ops here  i've added you to the Research Notion space and the Drive folder `research-recordings`. Interview scripts are in Notion: Research > Templates > Interview & Screener. Consent language lives in Research > Ethics (top of the page). If Drive access is missing go to SSO -> Apps -> GSuite -> Request `research-view` and ping me.

Bea: great. process Q: do i need approvals to run a guerrilla test next week? and who runs the roadmap cadence?

Lydia: hi Bea  PM for Payments. small guerrilla tests (<=5 unpaid users) are fine with an intake note in the Research study template; paid recruits or PII require approvals. i'm the roadmap lead for Payments — weekly sync is Tues 10am, i'll add you to the invite and link the quarter roadmap in Notion.

Marco: design ops notes: Design Crits are Tue 3pm (1-slide, 5-min context). device lab booking via the Device Lab calendar (link in #device-lab) or `/calendar book device-lab`. File naming conventions & component rules are in the "Design Playbook" FigJam.

Bea: awesome — can someone add me to Design Crits + the roadmap sync? i'd also love to shadow a user call this week if possible.

Tess: added you to both invites. send me a study ID and i'll grant shadow access to the recordings; i can also drop a few recent screener examples in this thread.

Product Onboarding Bot: onboarding checklist summary: Figma access  confirmed; Notion Roadmap + Research templates  shared; Drive recordings  access granted; Tokens repo link  github.com/redwood/design-tokens; Calendar invites  Design Crits + Roadmap sent.

Bea: all set, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
